detail.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Support NVCRE init containers for llmb K8s workloads

# Changelog

Added --nvcre_init_containers_json, forwarded to NvcreExecutor.init_containers, and
--nvcre_bridge_root (default /opt/Megatron-Bridge) so the generated command and
PYTHONPATH can use a Megatron-Bridge checkout that an init container placed in the
pod instead of the image's copy.

+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+
+"""Run the launcher's Megatron-Bridge checkout in NVCRE pods instead of the image's copy.
+
+On Slurm the launcher's checkout is bind-mounted over the image's ``/opt/Megatron-Bridge``.
+Pods have no such mount, so an init container clones the same Megatron-Bridge commit into
+a volume that the training container shares."""
+
+import re
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, NamedTuple
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit
+
+
+BRIDGE_POD_ROOT = "/mnt/workspace/megatron-bridge"
+WORKSPACE_VOLUME: dict[str, Any] = {"name": "workspace", "emptyDir": {}}
+WORKSPACE_MOUNT: dict[str, Any] = {"name": "workspace", "mountPath": "/mnt/workspace"}
+
+
+class LocalBridge(NamedTuple):
+    """Where the launcher's checkout can be fetched from, and at which commit."""
+
+    url: str
+    commit: str
+
+
+def _git(repo_root: Path, *args: str) -> str:
+    return subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), *args], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
+    ).stdout.strip()
+
+
+def pod_clone_url(remote_url: str) -> str:
+    """HTTPS URL a pod can clone anonymously: SSH remotes are rewritten and any credentials dropped."""
+    # scp-style ``git@host:path``: the colon separates host from path.
+    scp = re.match(r"^git@([^:/]+):(.+)$", remote_url)
+    if scp:
+        return f"https://{scp.group(1)}/{scp.group(2)}"
+    parts = urlsplit(remote_url)
+    if parts.scheme == "ssh" and parts.hostname:
+        # The port of an ssh:// URL is the SSH port, which does not apply over HTTPS.
+        return urlunsplit(("https", parts.hostname, parts.path, "", ""))
+    if parts.scheme in ("http", "https") and parts.hostname:
+        host = parts.hostname + (f":{parts.port}" if parts.port else "")
+        return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, host, parts.path, "", ""))
+    raise ValueError(f"Cannot derive a clone URL a pod can reach from remote {remote_url!r}")
+
+
+def local_bridge_source(repo_root: Path) -> LocalBridge:
+    """The origin URL and checked-out commit of the Megatron-Bridge checkout at ``repo_root``."""
+    try:
+        url = pod_clone_url(_git(repo_root, "config", "--get", "remote.origin.url"))
+        commit = _git(repo_root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+        # Submodule pointers are ignored: only this repository's own commit is fetched.
+        dirty = _git(repo_root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no", "--ignore-submodules=all")
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"--nvcre_use_mbridge_commit needs {repo_root} to be a git checkout with an 'origin' remote: {exc.stderr}"
+        ) from exc
+    if dirty:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"--nvcre_use_mbridge_commit runs commit {commit} in the pods, but {repo_root} has uncommitted changes "
+            "to tracked files. Commit and push them, or stash them, and resubmit."
+        )
+    return LocalBridge(url, commit)
+
+
+def bridge_init_container(source: LocalBridge, image: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Init container that clones ``source`` into ``BRIDGE_POD_ROOT``; ``image`` is the training image (has git)."""
+    steps = [
+        "set -ex",
+        f"git init -q {BRIDGE_POD_ROOT}",
+        f"cd {BRIDGE_POD_ROOT}",
+        f"git remote add origin {shlex.quote(source.url)}",
+        f"git fetch -q --depth 1 origin {shlex.quote(source.commit)}",
+        "git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD",
+    ]
+    return {
+        "name": "megatron-bridge-clone",
+        "image": image,
+        "command": ["/bin/bash", "-c"],
+        "args": ["\n".join(steps)],
+        "volumeMounts": [dict(WORKSPACE_MOUNT)],  # a copy: shared objects would be dumped as YAML anchors
+    }

+"""Tests for scripts/performance/utils/nvcre_bridge.py — running the launcher's checkout in NVCRE pods."""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit
+
+_PERF_SCRIPTS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "scripts" / "performance"
+if str(_PERF_SCRIPTS_DIR) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(_PERF_SCRIPTS_DIR))
+
+from utils import nvcre_bridge  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def _git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def checkout(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
+    """A git checkout with an origin remote, like a real Megatron-Bridge clone."""
+    repo = tmp_path / "bridge"
+    repo.mkdir()
+    _git(repo, "init", "-q")
+    _git(repo, "config", "user.email", "t@example.com")
+    _git(repo, "config", "user.name", "t")
+    _git(repo, "remote", "add", "origin", "https://github.com/example/Megatron-Bridge.git")
+    (repo / "README").write_text("x")
+    _git(repo, "add", "README")
+    _git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "init")
+    return repo
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "remote, expected",
+    [
+        ("https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge.git", "https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge.git"),
+        ("git@github.com:NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge.git", "https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge.git"),
+        ("ssh://git@github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge.git", "https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge.git"),
+        # the port of an ssh:// URL is the SSH port; it must not leak into the HTTPS URL or its path
+        ("ssh://git@gitlab.example.com:2222/o/r.git", "https://gitlab.example.com/o/r.git"),
+        ("git@gitlab.example.com:o/sub/r.git", "https://gitlab.example.com/o/sub/r.git"),
+        # credentials must never end up in the WorkloadRun spec
+        ("https://user:secret-token@github.com/o/r.git", "https://github.com/o/r.git"),  # pragma: allowlist secret
+        ("https://gitlab.example.com:8443/o/r.git", "https://gitlab.example.com:8443/o/r.git"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_pod_clone_url(remote: str, expected: str) -> None:
+    assert nvcre_bridge.pod_clone_url(remote) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("remote", ["/srv/git/bridge.git", "file:///srv/git/bridge.git", "../bridge"])
+def test_pod_clone_url_rejects_remotes_a_pod_cannot_reach(remote: str) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="clone URL"):
+        nvcre_bridge.pod_clone_url(remote)
+
+
+def test_local_bridge_source_reads_origin_and_head(checkout: Path) -> None:
+    source = nvcre_bridge.local_bridge_source(checkout)
+
+    assert source.url == "https://github.com/example/Megatron-Bridge.git"
+    assert source.commit == _git(checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+
+
+def test_local_bridge_source_requires_a_git_checkout_with_origin(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="origin"):
+        nvcre_bridge.local_bridge_source(tmp_path)
+
+
+def test_local_bridge_source_rejects_uncommitted_changes(checkout: Path) -> None:
+    (checkout / "README").write_text("changed")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="uncommitted"):
+        nvcre_bridge.local_bridge_source(checkout)
+
+
+def test_local_bridge_source_rejects_staged_changes(checkout: Path) -> None:
+    (checkout / "README").write_text("changed")
+    _git(checkout, "add", "README")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="uncommitted"):
+        nvcre_bridge.local_bridge_source(checkout)
+
+
+def test_local_bridge_source_ignores_untracked_files(checkout: Path) -> None:
+    (checkout / "scratch.txt").write_text("not tracked")
+
+    assert nvcre_bridge.local_bridge_source(checkout).commit == _git(checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+
+
+def test_local_bridge_source_ignores_a_drifted_submodule(checkout: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Only this repository's commit is fetched, so a submodule checked out at another commit is not a dirty tree."""
+    sub_repo = tmp_path / "sub_repo"
+    sub_repo.mkdir()
+    _git(sub_repo, "init", "-q")
+    _git(sub_repo, "config", "user.email", "t@example.com")
+    _git(sub_repo, "config", "user.name", "t")
+    (sub_repo / "f").write_text("1")
+    _git(sub_repo, "add", "f")
+    _git(sub_repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "one")
+    recorded = _git(sub_repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+    _git(checkout, "update-index", "--add", "--cacheinfo", f"160000,{recorded},3rdparty/sub")
+    _git(checkout, "commit", "-q", "-m", "add submodule")
+    _git(checkout, "clone", "-q", str(sub_repo), "3rdparty/sub")
+    (checkout / "3rdparty" / "sub" / "f").write_text("2")
+    _git(
+        checkout / "3rdparty" / "sub",
+        "-c",
+        "user.email=t@example.com",
+        "-c",
+        "user.name=t",
+        "commit",
+        "-qam",
+        "two",
+    )
+    assert "3rdparty/sub" in _git(checkout, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no")  # git sees drift
+
+    assert nvcre_bridge.local_bridge_source(checkout).commit == _git(checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+
+
+def test_bridge_init_container_fetches_the_exact_commit() -> None:

+

+
+    assert container["name"] == "megatron-bridge-clone"
+    assert container["image"] == "nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo:26.08.01"  # the training image, which has git
+    assert container["volumeMounts"] == [nvcre_bridge.WORKSPACE_MOUNT]
+    script = container["args"][0]
+    assert f"git fetch -q --depth 1 origin {'a' * 40}" in script
+    assert "git remote add origin https://github.com/o/r.git" in script
+    assert "submodule" not in script  # only the Megatron-Bridge commit is fetched
+    assert nvcre_bridge.BRIDGE_POD_ROOT in script
+
+
+def test_bridge_init_container_quotes_the_url() -> None:
+    source = nvcre_bridge.LocalBridge("https://github.com/o/r.git; rm -rf /", "a" * 40)
+
+    assert "'https://github.com/o/r.git; rm -rf /'" in nvcre_bridge.bridge_init_container(source, "img")["args"][0]

SSH remotes that include a port get rewritten into a broken URL:  `pod_clone_url("ssh://git@gitlab.example.com:2222/o/r.git")`  →  `https://gitlab.example.com/2222/o/r.git`
 The single regex handles both SSH styles,  `git@host:o/r.git ` and  `ssh://git@host/o/r.git` . In the first style the  `:`  separates the host from the path. In the second it's a port, so  2222  ends up as part of the path. Could we keep the regex for  `git@host:path`  and handle  `ssh://`  URLs with  urlsplit , dropping the SSH port since it doesn't apply over HTTPS?

issue_comments.body:
I think we should invert the call logic. Right now this is a passthrough essentially of nvcre nemo-run flags. When jobs are launched via setup_experiment.py it already knows which commit is and repo location.

I'd argue we should have a flag like `--nvcre_use_mbridge_commit` or similar. This grabs the necessary information during setup_experiment.py to create the json nvcre needs and passes it along.

Makes the whole flow simpler.
